description: Attachment 0010 showed the signature management requirements at P3 in column F while the latest revision of the requirements had them at P2. The Government response: "Attachment 0010 will be corrected to reflect signature management requirement P2 in column F." A document correction to match an existing revision — not a re-prioritisation decision, and not dated to one.
source: ACC-DTA, OMFV Phase 3-4 Solicitation W56HZV-22-R-0026 Questions and Answers 01-140, 25 October 2022, Q&A control no. 021, PDF p. 5
